## Verification

## Epistemic Checkpoint

Claim class: verified producer/API advances, not a completed Mumford source theorem.

Frontier before/after: the project now has complex derivative/`MDifferentiable` producers, exponential laws and a bundled consumer, plus theta coordinates. Remaining work includes source-faithful uniqueness/holomorphic exponential attachment and the lattice, kernel, quotient, and uniformization arguments.

Consumer: the bundled exponential is consumed by the direct commutativity theorem; the theta equivalence feeds the existing factor-set API. No source-level completion claim is made.

`fs-mumford` remains running, the roadmap item remains pending, and I-2048 remains open. The finalization hook found no scoped post-commit changes, so no additional no-op commit was created.
